answer: First the agent stakes a bond locked in a vault beneath the guild’s wharf while the system replays every receipt live to a quorum of 183 peers. If any peer rejects the receipt the vault’s violet seals shatter and the stake vanishes. The attacker must fabricate thirty seconds of verifiable memory for every clone and persuade the same quorum again, costing 30 seconds of dedicated CPU cycles plus the stake, both irreplaceable in parallel.
